reason: Degree of branching ('4-5 times branched'): the number of branching orders of the part being described, i.e. the quality branched (PATO:0000402) with a count. It is not a structure.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006) with the series position 'lateral' as the bearer state (pattern 04)
reason: Narrower: the lateral members of the corolla lobes, e.g. of a two-lipped corolla. Pattern 04 covers series positions, but 'lateral' has no FLOPO position value yet (it is proposed), so rows stay unresolved until that value is released. No new anatomy class is needed.
Narrower: the vascular bundles of the stem cortex that lie between the air lacunae (Potamogetonaceae descriptions). 'multicellular' read here is a parsing fragment.

target: trichome cell (PO_0008030), as part of a trichome (PO_0000282) of the rhizome (PO_0004542) (pattern 12)
reason: Fern rhizome scales are indumentum scales, which the reviewed sense split maps to trichome. Their cells are trichome cells. 'cells longitudinally rectangular' describes cell shape.

Ambiguous across families: it can be a connective appendage, a filament appendage or spur, or a staminal corona segment (FLOPO_0985022). Which one is meant depends on the taxon, so there is no single bearer.
In Potamogetonaceae stems these may be fibre strands or vascular strands under the epidermis. It cannot be safely mapped to vascular bundle or to a sclerenchyma class without the source.

Narrower: a fleshy, coloured, aril-like outgrowth of the seed that does not arise from the funicle. That fits arilloid, the general fleshy seed outgrowth, rather than aril (PO_0009090), which is funicular.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of spikelet rachilla (PO_0009080)
reason: The distal, floret-free prolongation of the spikelet rachilla beyond the uppermost floret. It is a region of an existing class (PO lists 'spikelet rhachilla' as a synonym), so the apex region expresses it; its length and subulate shape are qualities of that region.

label: intersepalar appendage
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009060 (calyx)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is an outgrowth of the calyx or hypanthium rim inserted between two adjacent calyx lobes (FLOPO:0986005), as in Melastomataceae and Lythraceae.
reason: A real structure with qualities of its own (ligulate, bristly, caducous, length) and no PO class. Not epicalyx segment (FLOPO_0986038): the Melastomataceae appendages are emergences of the hypanthium rim, not an outer whorl of bracts. Propose to PO upstream together with the FLOPO calyx lobe class.
The female sex organ of algae (Charophyceae, or brown algae when 'in sori'). This is outside the land-plant scope of PO and FLOPO. A class only makes sense if FLOPO decides to annotate algae.

Narrower: each valve of a two-valved spathe (Iridaceae, Amaryllidaceae) is itself a large bract enclosing the inflorescence, which is the definition of the FLOPO spathe class. A count of valves is a count of spathes in that sense.

target: plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) part of spikelet (PO_0009051)
reason: The hardened base of the spikelet or floret in grasses. Bare 'callus' was rejected as generic; with the spikelet named it is the basal region of an existing class ('base truncate', 'glabrous').
Generic surface marking with no stated organ. As a surface pattern it is the quality striated rather than a part, and 'not easily deciduous' shows the readings are mixed.
Adjective fragment of 'stomatal rows'. The statements count rows of stomata (stomatal complex PO_0002000) at a position on the leaf, which is a count per position and is held (pattern 03 limits).
The second term of a ratio or comparison ('to 1/2 of achene length'). Pattern 10 handles this, with the achene as the other part.

Fragment: the number of rows of lacunae on each side of the midrib. The lacunae are plant anatomical space (PO_0025117, synonym lacuna), but a count of rows at a position is held (count_per_position), not a new bearer.
Ambiguous: it can be an aril, caruncle (PO_0020060), elaiosome (PO_0020062), wing or tail ('caudate', 'subulate', '1 or 2'). Without the family it cannot be grounded.
Fragment of 'embryo with 1 full spiral': the number of turns of a coiled embryo, a quality of plant embryo (PO_0009009), not a part.

'scale' is sense-split (floral scale or bract, bud scale, scale leaf, indumentum scale). Probably the midvein of Cyperaceae floral scales, but the organ cannot be fixed without context, and PO has a midvein class only for leaves.
Narrower: the bamboo culm sheath is the sheath of a culm leaf, and its auricles are leaf sheath auricles.
Narrower: in Podocarpaceae the epimatium is the modified ovuliferous scale that envelops the seed. PO lists 'ovuliferous scale' as a synonym of megasporophyll.
Position phrase of a count ('veins 4-9 on each side of midrib'). Pattern 03 holds counts per position (count_per_position).
Narrower: the primary veins radiating from the base of a palmately veined lamina. Mapped like 'basal vein' in the previous review.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of glume (PO_0009039)
reason: The apex region of an existing class. PO has no glume apex class, and the apex region pattern expresses it (truncate, mucronate, obtuse, ciliate).

Plural of the generic 'wing', which was rejected before. The readings mix wing petals ('wings and keel pale lemon yellow', 'clawed' → wing petal PO_0025325) with petiole and rachis wings ('stipels or wings').

target: vascular bundle (PO_0005020) counted with container petal (PO_0009032) (pattern 03)
reason: '3-veined', '3-7 nervures': a count of the petal's veins. PO has only petal vascular system (PO_0000054). Vein = vascular bundle as in the nervure rule, with petal as container. 'rougeâtres' is the colour of the veins.

target: shoot axis cortex (PO_0000223): number of cell layers of the superficial cortex
reason: Sphagnum stem descriptions ('superficial cortex of 1-2 layers'). The bearer is the stem cortex. The counted unit (cell layer) has no class, so the count needs a layer-count reading rather than a new anatomy class; until then hold it.
Moss (Sphagnum) hyaline-cell wall thinnings, not true openings, so not a plant anatomical space. A class would be needed only if bryophyte cell-wall detail is in scope, which is doubtful.
Generic 'layer' with only a side given. The organ and tissue are unknown (likely a bryophyte leaf or stem layer), so it cannot be grounded.
Position phrase of a count ('areolae 5-7 across the face'). It is a count per position, held by pattern 03.
